name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the feature?

path.description: Directory the feature folder is created in. Defaults to `<sourceRoot>/app/modules/admin` (sourceRoot read from angular.json), or the `fuse-feature.path` value of fuse-schematics.json.

project.description: Project in angular.json to read sourceRoot from. Defaults to the first application project.

prefix.description: Component selector prefix. Defaults to `app`, or the `fuse-feature.prefix` value of fuse-schematics.json.

fields.description: Comma-separated field list `name:type[:modifier...]`. Types: string, string(N), text, int, number, decimal(p,s), boolean, date, json, enum(a|b), relation(Entity), relation(Entity[]), file(kind), file(kind)[]. Modifiers: unique, index, default(x), min(n), max(n), label(field), cascade, set-null. A trailing `?` marks a field optional, e.g. "name:string,price:number,category:relation(Category),tags:relation(Tag[])?,image:file(image)?,status:enum(active|blocked)". Takes precedence over --openapi. Defaults to a single required `name:string` field.

openapi.description: OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 document (JSON or YAML) to take the fields from when --fields is not given: a path relative to the workspace root or an http(s) URL, e.g. http://localhost:3000/docs/admin-json. Without --schema the fields come from the CRUD resource matching the feature name (`/admin/<name>` paths).

schema.description: Name of the OpenAPI schema to take the fields from (e.g. CreateMahsulotDto). Requires --openapi.

skipRoute.description: Do not register the lazy route in <sourceRoot>/app/app.routes.ts

skipNav.description: Do not add a menu item to <sourceRoot>/app/core/navigation/navigation.ts

skipI18n.description: Do not add translation keys to <sourceRoot>/assets/i18n/*.json
